sources.title: Abu Dhabi DED licensing requirements
sources.publisher: Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development
supportedClaims: ADDED licensing services include economic licences and permits.
Primary services include reserving a trade name, issuing, renewing, cancelling and amending an economic licence.
Licence types shown include Abu Dhabi Trader, Dual Licence, Freelancer Licence, Standard Licence and Virtual Licence.
limitations: Specific activity eligibility, final fees and issue status remain with ADDED/TAMM.

sources.title: ADGM Registration and Incorporation
supportedClaims: ADGM Registration Authority licenses and registers ADGM establishments.
Applications can be submitted through the ADGM Online Registry Solution.
The process starts with business plan and documentation review, then application submission to the Registrar.
limitations: Bankable must not claim ADGM submission or approval without an ADGM/provider event or explicit user/HR reference.

sources.title: KEZAD free zone business setup solutions
supportedClaims: KEZAD offers Mainland and Free Zone facilities.
Free zone startup solutions include licences, shared workstations or dedicated offices.
The setup flow shown is choose package, submit documents and payments, receive licence.
limitations: Published package prices and visa provisions may change; final eligibility and licence issue belong to KEZAD.

sources.title: Abu Dhabi Green Visa - Freelancers
supportedClaims: The page lists a freelance work permit from MoHRE as a criterion.
The page lists bachelor's degree, specialized diploma or equivalent as a criterion.
The page lists AED 360,000 annual self-employment income for the previous two years or proof of financial solvency.
The page says nomination request submission for this category is currently unavailable through ADRO.
limitations: Availability of the official application path needs provider confirmation at the time of action.

sources.title: Work permits
sources.publisher: The Official Portal of the UAE Government
supportedClaims: MoHRE issues work permits to establishments registered with it.
The Work Bundle covers issuance, renewal and cancellation of work permits and residency visas.
The Work Bundle includes medical examination and fingerprinting services required for Emirates ID issuance.
limitations: The page describes government process; individual case status requires official/provider reference.

sources.title: Residence visa for working in the UAE
sources.publisher: The Official Portal of the UAE Government
supportedClaims: Standard work visa is for employees of government and private sectors.
The employer must apply for the standard work visa.
The page distinguishes Green Visa, standard work visa and domestic worker visa routes.
limitations: Validity and conditions remain subject to visa-issuing authority rules.

sources.title: Leasing a property in the UAE
sources.publisher: The Official Portal of the UAE Government
supportedClaims: Tenant documents include passport copy, valid residence visa and Emirates ID.
Post-dated cheques cover payments for the agreed lease period.
Abu Dhabi landlords register lease contracts in Tawtheeq.
Broker commission may be up to 5% of total rent.
limitations: Specific cheque count, deposit amount and agent admin charges are not universal rules from this source.

sources.title: Residential municipality fees
supportedClaims: Residential municipality fees are collected with water and electricity bills.
The fee is calculated at 5% of rental value or rental index, whichever is higher.
Registering the tenancy with Tawtheeq automatically enrolls the tenant for municipality fees.
limitations: Utility connection and fee billing status belongs to TAQA Distribution and the municipality.

sources.title: Getting a health insurance
sources.publisher: The Official Portal of the UAE Government
supportedClaims: In Abu Dhabi, employers and sponsors are responsible for health insurance coverage for employees and their families.
The family coverage text names one spouse and three children under 18.
Private-sector employee health insurance is a prerequisite for residence permit issuance or renewal under the described scheme.
limitations: Policy issue, network and premium details belong to insurers and competent authorities.

sources.title: Mortgage loan important ratios
supportedClaims: The rulebook sets loan-to-value limits for mortgages.
Debt burden ratio is capped at 50% of gross income.
Maximum tenor and income-multiple constraints are listed.
limitations: These are readiness factors, not lender approval or pre-approval.

sources.title: ADREC rental index interactive map
supportedClaims: The rental index is a general guide to rental prices across the Emirate of Abu Dhabi.
The rental index is based on aggregate data.
ADREC states the index should not be used as a legal reference for the exact rental value of any residential unit.
limitations: Use as an official benchmark only; do not treat it as a live listing, completed lease, or exact rent for a unit.

sources.title: Open Current Account Online UAE - Quick guide
supportedClaims: Emirates NBD says current accounts are open to individual UAE resident customers, both salaried and non-salaried.
For self-employed or non-salaried applicants, the page says a trade licence or three-month bank statement can substitute for a salary certificate.
Core documents listed include passport, UAE residence visa page, original Emirates ID, salary certificate or trade licence/bank statement, and proof of address.
The page states Personal Banking Classic has no minimum salary requirement but has a minimum average monthly balance.
limitations: This is one bank provider route; account approval and onboarding status belong to the bank.

sources.title: ADGM Visa and Government Services
supportedClaims: ADGM says all visa and government services are processed online through ACCESSADGM.
Newly registered ADGM entities must apply for an Establishment Card and E-Channels account for visa-related services.
The page says ADGM entities can login to ACCESSADGM and apply for the required visa service.
limitations: ADGM and competent authority approvals remain provider-owned; Bankable records only sourced handoffs and reported references.

sources.title: KEZAD tariffs
supportedClaims: The tariff page lists Establishment Card services.
The tariff page lists Employment Residence under Permitting Services.
The tariff page lists Residence Permit Renewal, ID Card and Residence Permit Cancellation services.
limitations: Tariffs are provider-published and may change; eligibility, submission and approval remain with KEZAD and competent authorities.

sources.title: About Masdar City
supportedClaims: Masdar City states it is located in Abu Dhabi.
The page describes Masdar City as connected to sustainability, business ecosystem and innovation themes.
limitations: This validates Masdar City as a named Abu Dhabi place only; housing fit still requires live listing or rental evidence.

sources.title: WeWork Hub71 Abu Dhabi
supportedClaims: WeWork Hub71 is listed at Al Khatem Tower, ADGM Square, Al Maryah Island.
The page describes coworking areas and flexible private offices.
The page offers a location interest, tour or sales contact path.
limitations: Booking confirmation and pricing require WeWork action or response.

sources.title: Cloud Spaces locations
supportedClaims: Cloud Spaces lists Abu Dhabi locations at Yas Mall, The Mall World Trade Center and Abu Dhabi Global Market.
The page includes contact/enquiry form fields.
The Galleria location is shown as opening soon, not active.
limitations: Availability and final membership terms require provider confirmation.

sources.title: Cloud Spaces Yas Mall
supportedClaims: The location is Level 1, Town Square, Yas Mall, Yas Island.
The page offers Book Now and Enquire Now actions.
The page lists coworking day access and monthly products with published starting prices.
limitations: Displayed prices are provider-published and may change before booking.

sources.title: Cloud Spaces ADGM
supportedClaims: The location is Level 11, 14 and 15, Al Sarab Tower, Al Maryah Island.
The page offers Book a Tour and Enquire Now actions.
The page describes private offices, dedicated desks, meeting rooms and event spaces.
limitations: Booking and office availability require provider confirmation.

sources.title: ADGM office space
supportedClaims: ADGM lists Cloud Spaces, Regus, Signature, The Executive Centre and WeWork/Hub71 as business centre options.
Cloud Spaces is identified as located in ADGM's Al Sarab Tower.
Regus is described as serviced and coworking office space in Al Maqam Tower.
limitations: ADGM office-space descriptions are not booking confirmations.

sources.title: The Department of Municipalities and Transport Opens 33 Parks in Mohamed Bin Zayed City
supportedClaims: DMT announced the opening of 33 new parks in Mohamed Bin Zayed City.
The parks include picnic areas, shaded seating, children’s play areas, fitness zones, jogging tracks and sports courts.
DMT describes the parks as part of its liveability strategy for residents and accessible outdoor zones.
limitations: The parks announcement supports area facilities only; it does not prove rent levels, listing availability or commute time.

sources.title: Aldar and DMT to deliver 9,000 rental units in Abu Dhabi as part of Value Housing Programme
supportedClaims: Abu Dhabi Media Office reported a DMT and Aldar partnership for integrated communities in Mohamed Bin Zayed City and Baniyas.
The MBZ City project is described as a mixed-use residential community with single occupancy accommodation, multi-tenant apartments, on-site amenities and ancillary retail.
The developments are due for completion in 2029.
limitations: This is future development context and must not be presented as current available stock unless a separate listing or provider source exists.

sources.title: Amazing Studio with Parking in Mohamed Bin Zayed City
supportedClaims: Opened listing page showed AED 24,000 yearly rent.
Opened listing page showed Studio, 1 bath, 658 sqft in Mohamed Bin Zayed City, Abu Dhabi.
Opened listing page showed Updated 24th September 2026 and reference ID 105317-XsIHCQ.
limitations: Availability, final rent, payment schedule and provider response must be confirmed on the portal or with the agent.
This single listing validates one observed home location, not the area’s general rent level.

areas.summary: Included for rental benchmarking through ADREC rental-index guidance; rank homes only after affordability, allowance and listing-source checks pass.

areas.summary: Included for rental benchmarking through ADREC rental-index guidance; avoid commute, amenity or rent-level claims unless a dated source is attached.

services.title: Mainland company setup through ADDED
services.nextAction: Open ADDED licensing requirements, choose activity/licence route, then record the TAMM reference only after official submission.
requirements: Choose licence or permit category.
Use primary services such as trade-name reservation and economic licence issue where applicable.
Confirm activity and premises requirements with ADDED/TAMM.
limitations: This is not a generic legal checklist and does not apply to ADGM or KEZAD setup.

services.title: ADGM registration and incorporation
services.nextAction: Prepare business plan and checklist evidence, then open ADGM Online Registry Solution.
requirements: Review legal-structure checklist.
Prepare application documents.
Submit through ADGM registry channel and track official responses.
limitations: Bankable can record an opened handoff or user-reported reference; it cannot sync ADGM status without approved access.

services.title: KEZAD free zone setup
services.nextAction: Choose KEZAD package and workspace option, then submit documents and payments through KEZAD channels.
requirements: Choose free zone or mainland facility path.
Choose package and visa provision level.
Submit documents and payments to KEZAD.
limitations: KEZAD approval, timing and licence issue remain provider-owned.

services.title: Mainland / MoHRE employee work permit and residence handoff
services.nextAction: For a mainland/MoHRE-registered employer, HR opens the official Work Bundle path and records a reference only after submission.
requirements: Employer-owned MoHRE work permit or renewal flow for establishments registered with MoHRE.
Medical examination and fingerprinting where required for Emirates ID.
Provider, HR or employee reference for any submitted or confirmed state.
limitations: Opening the official portal is only opened; it is not submitted or approved.
Do not show this as the universal route for ADGM or KEZAD entities.

services.title: ADGM employee visa and government services
services.nextAction: For an ADGM entity, HR uses ACCESSADGM visa and government services and records official references after provider submission.
requirements: ADGM entity creates or uses ACCESSADGM account.
Apply for Establishment Card and E-Channels account where required.
Apply for required employee visa service through ACCESSADGM.
limitations: ADGM and competent authority approvals remain provider-owned; no automatic Bankable status sync is verified.

services.title: KEZAD employment residence services
services.nextAction: For a KEZAD entity, HR confirms the relevant KEZAD permitting service and records the provider reference after submission.
requirements: Establishment Card service where applicable.
Employment Residence service where applicable.
Residence Permit Renewal, ID Card or cancellation service where applicable.
limitations: Tariff presence does not prove eligibility for a specific employee; KEZAD and competent authorities decide.

services.title: ADDED Freelancer Licence route
services.nextAction: Open ADDED licensing requirements, confirm the Freelancer Licence activity path, then record official references only after provider submission.
requirements: Confirm activity eligibility for Freelancer Licence.
Prepare evidence requested by ADDED/TAMM for the selected activity.
Use the official ADDED/TAMM service for submission.
limitations: ADDED lists Freelancer Licence as a licence type; activity-specific requirements and approval remain with ADDED/TAMM.

services.title: Freelancer Green Visa readiness
services.nextAction: Check freelance permit, education and income or solvency evidence; confirm application availability with the official provider.
requirements: Freelance work permit from MoHRE.
Bachelor's degree, specialized diploma or equivalent.
AED 360,000 annual self-employment income for the previous two years or proof of financial solvency.
limitations: ADRO states this nomination request is currently unavailable through ADRO.

services.title: Personal current account readiness
services.nextAction: Review bank document readiness and open the bank application only when the person chooses to apply.
requirements: Valid passport and UAE residence visa page.
Original Emirates ID.
Salary certificate or, for non-salaried applicants, trade licence or three-month bank statement.
Proof of address such as tenancy contract or utility bill.
limitations: This is a bank-provider readiness route, not an approval or account-opening guarantee.

services.title: Tawtheeq tenancy registration handoff
services.nextAction: Ask the agent or landlord how Tawtheeq will be registered and record the official tenancy reference once available.
requirements: Passport copy, valid residence visa and Emirates ID.
Post-dated cheques covering the agreed lease period.
Registered Tawtheeq contract for Abu Dhabi tenancy.
limitations: No agent contact button should appear for synthetic homes.

services.title: Abu Dhabi health insurance enrollment
services.nextAction: HR confirms the insurer or broker path and records policy evidence when issued.
requirements: Employer or sponsor coverage responsibility in Abu Dhabi.
Employee and eligible family coverage details confirmed by provider.
Policy evidence recorded only when issued.
limitations: Bankable tracks the task; it does not issue insurance.

financialFactors.title: Mortgage loan-to-value
financialFactors.detail: Compare the property price, deposit and requested loan against CBUAE LTV limits before starting a lender application.

financialFactors.title: Debt burden ratio
financialFactors.detail: Estimate whether total monthly debts fit within the CBUAE 50% gross-income DBR factor; the lender decides using its own assessment.

financialFactors.title: Tenor and income multiple
financialFactors.detail: Check tenor and income-multiple factors early so the user understands what may block a mortgage conversation.

financialFactors.title: Current account document readiness
financialFactors.detail: Prepare Emirates ID, passport, visa page, address proof and salary certificate or non-salaried substitute before opening a bank application.
